mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 64 degrees with slight rain near Badger Ridge Middle School. If you look west-northwest over Cross Plains at 8:23 PM, you can see the space station cruising toward Madison for the next 6 minutes under a Waxing Crescent moon. Expect an overnight low of 61 degrees with rain continuing through the night.

The Verona Police Department released a summary of calls from August 31 to September 14, which included a variety of incidents ranging from traffic citations to a burglary on Hunters Cove Way involving a recovered firearm.
Today you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, the town is hopping with activity including Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee, and Dream Day Trivia at Paddy Mac's.
On September 3, a 33-year-old Madison man was arrested for an O W I, second offence, after crashing his vehicle on Shooting Star Road.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a remodel, so there is no flavor of the day to report. The store remains closed for this project while they update the facility.
